}

.mes-app {
  background-color: #0d1117 !important;
  font-family: 'Noto Sans KR', 'Roboto', sans-serif !important;
}

/* Scrollbar Styling */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 6px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: #161b22;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #30363d;
  border-radius: 3px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: #00e5ff;
}
</style>
